chart.causes.callout: Weather at the two ends of the flight explains 18.8% of arrival delay minutes (interval 17.7% to 19.9%); the weather field records 4.2% and the air traffic system field 22.3%.

provenance.population: scheduled flights 2023 to 2026-07, flights between two Core 30 airports for the weather model

chart.causes.sql:
select f.flight_id, f.flight_date, f.origin || ':' || cast(f.dep_hour as varchar) as origin_hour,
           f.dest || ':' || cast(cast(f.crs_arr_local // 60 as integer) % 24 as varchar) as dest_hour,
           f.year * 100 + f.month as period, f.arr_delay,
           least(coalesce(origin_precipitation, 0), 10) as origin_precip,
           least(coalesce(origin_snowfall, 0), 5) as origin_snow,
           greatest(coalesce(origin_wind_gusts, 0) - 40.0, 0) as origin_gust,
           coalesce(origin_low_cloud, 0) / 100.0 as origin_low_cloud,
           coalesce(origin_thunder, false)::int as origin_thunder,
           coalesce(origin_fog, false)::int as origin_fog,
           coalesce(origin_freezing, false)::int as origin_freezing,
           least(coalesce(dest_precipitation, 0), 10) as dest_precip,
           least(coalesce(dest_snowfall, 0), 5) as dest_snow,
           greatest(coalesce(dest_wind_gusts, 0) - 40.0, 0) as dest_gust,
           coalesce(dest_low_cloud, 0) / 100.0 as dest_low_cloud,
           coalesce(dest_thunder, false)::int as dest_thunder,
           coalesce(dest_fog, false)::int as dest_fog,
           coalesce(dest_freezing, false)::int as dest_freezing,
           coalesce(greatest(0, l.prev_arr_delay - (l.sched_turn - 45)), 0) as carried,
           f.cause_weather, f.cause_nas, f.cause_ok
    from (select * from wh.fct_flights where year between 2023 and 2026) f
    left join wh.int_legs l on l.flight_id = f.flight_id and l.link_status = 'linked'
    where f.weather_both_ends and not f.cancelled and not f.diverted and f.arr_delay is not null
    order by f.flight_id
chart.causes.subtitle: Share of arrival delay minutes: the reported cause fields beside the weather model's estimate
chart.causes.title: Weather explains more delay than the weather field records

chart.decision.callout: At ATL, the busiest airport, the chance of missing a connection falls under 10% at a 65 minute buffer; the first leg of the aircraft's day is on time 85.8% of the time against 76.0% for the rest.
chart.decision.sql:
select dep_hour as key, count(*) as flights,
           avg(case when arr_delay < 15 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as on_time_rate,
           avg(arr_delay) as mean_delay
    from wh.fct_flights
    where not cancelled and not diverted and arr_delay is not null and (year between 2023 and 2026)
    group by 1 order by 1
chart.decision.subtitle: Chance of missing a connection by scheduled buffer at the three busiest hubs, with the line
chart.decision.title: Book the first flight of the aircraft's day, and leave 65 minutes to connect at ATL

chart.definition.callout: From 2015 to 2025 the on time rate moved -3.7 points; on the same 3,631 routes the schedule moved +4.6 minutes and the flying +4.4.
chart.definition.sql:
select year, flight_date,
           count(*) filter (where arr_delay < 15) as on_time,
           count(*) as flown
    from wh.fct_flights
    where not cancelled and not diverted and arr_delay is not null
    group by year, flight_date
    order by flight_date

-- the route panel
with flown as (
        select route, year, flight_date, crs_elapsed, actual_elapsed
        from wh.fct_flights
        where not cancelled and not diverted and arr_delay is not null and actual_elapsed is not null and crs_elapsed is not null and year in (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
    ),
    route_year as (select route, year, count(*) as n from flown group by route, year),
    panel as (
        select route, sum(n) as weight from route_year group by route having count(distinct year) = 11
    )
    select f.year, f.flight_date,
           sum(p.weight / ry.n * f.crs_elapsed) as sched_weighted,
           sum(p.weight / ry.n * f.actual_elapsed) as actual_weighted,
           sum(p.weight / ry.n) as weight
    from flown f
    join panel p using (route)
    join route_year ry on ry.route = f.route and ry.year = f.year
    group by f.year, f.flight_date
    order by f.flight_date
chart.definition.subtitle: On time rate, and scheduled and actual gate to gate minutes on a fixed panel of routes, by year
chart.definition.title: The on time rate fell, and flights took longer gate to gate and the schedule grew as much

chart.inherited.callout: rho = 1.068 on 18,381,035 linked legs: 34.9% of arrival delay minutes were inherited (interval 34.8% to 34.9%), against 37.4% in the reported late aircraft field.
chart.inherited.sql: select * from wh.int_legs where link_status = 'linked' and year(flight_date) between 2023 and 2026
chart.inherited.subtitle: Departure delay minutes passed on per minute of late inbound arrival, by scheduled turnaround
chart.inherited.title: About a third of arrival delay was inherited from the aircraft's previous flight, and a scheduled turn of 75 minutes halves what is passed on

chart.line.callout: 0 of 15 carriers pass Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05; pooled, the line's statistic sits -2.40 placebo standard deviations from the placebo mean.
chart.line.sql:
select cast(arr_delay as integer) as minute, count(*) as flights
    from wh.fct_flights
    where not cancelled and not diverted and arr_delay is not null
      and arr_delay >= -60 and arr_delay < 180 and (year between 2023 and 2026)
    group by 1 order by 1
chart.line.subtitle: Flights by whole minute of arrival delay, all carriers, with the fifteen minute line and the placebo lines
chart.line.title: No carrier's arrivals bunch under the fifteen minute line beyond what the placebos show

chart.meltdowns.callout: Threshold 29.0 chosen on 2015 to 2022 (inside the grid); 8 of 8 reporting year events flagged.
chart.meltdowns.sql:
select carrier as unit, flight_date as day, count(*) as scheduled,
           count(*) filter (where cancelled) as cancelled,
           avg(arr_delay) filter (where not cancelled and not diverted) as mean_delay
    from wh.fct_flights
    where (true)
    group by all order by unit, day
chart.meltdowns.subtitle: Daily cancellation rate of the carrier against other carriers at its ten busiest airports
chart.meltdowns.title: Southwest Airlines took 9 days to get back to its peers and Delta Air Lines 5; across every alert episode, how fast a carrier recovers is a trait of the carrier

chart.padding.callout: On the same routes, carriers, hours and months, padding moved +3.98 minutes from 2015 to 2025 while the flying moved +4.16; PELT found 204 steps of a minute or more across 20 carriers.
chart.padding.sql:
with base as (
        select carrier, make_date(cast(year as integer), cast(month as integer), 1) as period, padding,
               padding - avg(padding) over (partition by carrier, route) as within,
               avg(padding) over (partition by carrier) as overall
        from wh.fct_flights where padding is not null
    )
    select carrier, period, count(*) as flights, avg(within) + any_value(overall) as padding
    from base group by carrier, period order by carrier, period
chart.padding.subtitle: Mean padding per flight by month, minutes over the unimpeded block time, with each carrier's steps
chart.padding.title: The schedule grew as fast as the flying slowed, so it absorbed the delay

chart.ranking.callout: PSA Airlines moves from 11 to 7 once the routes, months, hours and aircraft are held constant; Hawaiian Airlines moves from 8 to 15.
chart.ranking.sql:
select carrier, route, year * 100 + month as period, dep_hour, coalesce(type_code, 'unknown') as type_code,
       count(*) as flights, avg(arr_delay) as arr_delay
from wh.fct_flights
where not cancelled and not diverted and arr_delay is not null and (year between 2023 and 2026)
group by all
chart.ranking.subtitle: Carrier rank on mean arrival delay, raw and adjusted for route, month, hour and aircraft type
chart.ranking.title: The ranking changes once you hold constant what each carrier flies: PSA Airlines rises 4 places and Hawaiian Airlines falls 7

plan.1.claim.value: The on time rate moved over the window by a different amount than the time flights actually spend gate to gate on the same routes, so the metric and the flying can tell different stories.

plan.1.estimator.value: Per year: the share of flown flights arriving less than fifteen minutes late, and the mean actual and scheduled gate to gate time on a fixed panel of routes flown in every year of the window.

plan.1.interval.value: Block bootstrap over days, 400 replicates, 95% percentile intervals.

plan.1.simulator.value: A two year simulated network whose padding steps on known dates while the flying does not change: the panel's scheduled block change against the true padding change, and whether the actual block change's interval covers zero, over twenty seeds.

plan.1.split.value: Descriptive over every year; nothing is fit, so there is nothing to choose on the fitting years.

plan.1.test.value: The change from the first full year to the latest full year in each series, with day bootstrap intervals.

plan.2.claim.value: Scheduled block time grew faster than unimpeded flying time on the same routes, hours and seasons, and the growth arrived in steps on dates that can be named for each carrier.

plan.2.estimator.value: Unimpeded block time is the 10th percentile of actual gate to gate time by route, three hour departure block and season over the fitting years; padding is scheduled block minus unimpeded; each carrier's monthly series is adjusted for route mix; PELT with a BIC penalty of two parameters finds the steps, and steps under one minute are not reported.

plan.2.family.value: One changepoint search per carrier; dates are reported, not tested.

plan.2.simulator.value: Padding error and changepoint date error by condition (recovery study).

plan.2.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the unimpeded reference is fixed on the fitting years and applied to every year.

plan.2.test.value: Padding change from the first to the latest full year on cells present in both, with intervals.

plan.3.claim.value: Arrival delays bunch just under fifteen minutes for some carriers, more than at placebo thresholds.

plan.3.estimator.value: Per carrier, counts by whole minute of arrival delay; a cubic fit to the log counts within twenty five minutes of the threshold, excluding five minutes either side; excess mass below plus missing mass above.

plan.3.family.value: Every reporting carrier in the test years, Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05.

plan.3.interval.value: Not an interval: a p value against placebos, and the excess mass as a share.

plan.3.simulator.value: False positive rate on clean carriers and power on planted carriers (recovery study).

plan.3.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the threshold, window, span and placebos are fixed here, and the test is reported on 2023 onward.

plan.3.test.value: The statistic at fifteen minutes standardized by its distribution at placebo thresholds from ten to sixty five minutes; one sided normal p value.

plan.4.claim.value: A large share of arrival delay minutes was inherited from the aircraft's previous leg rather than born on the leg, larger than the reported late aircraft field says.

plan.4.estimator.value: Rotations from tail numbers with the integrity rules; departure delay on the previous arrival's excess over the scheduled turn less a minimum turn, with carrier by date, origin by date and departure hour fixed effects; the buffer curve by scheduled turnaround bin.

plan.4.interval.value: Cluster robust by tail number and day for the coefficient.

plan.4.simulator.value: Coefficient bias and coverage, inherited share error (recovery study).

plan.4.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the minimum turn is chosen by profile on the fitting years and held fixed.

plan.4.test.value: The coefficient and the inherited share with intervals; the halving buffer.

plan.5.claim.value: Holding constant the routes, months, departure hours and aircraft types each carrier flies changes the carrier ranking on arrival delay.

plan.5.estimator.value: Arrival delay on carrier with route, month, departure hour and aircraft type fixed effects, weighted least squares on cells; effects relative to the flight weighted average carrier.

plan.5.family.value: Pairwise rank changes are described, not tested.

plan.5.interval.value: Cluster robust by day, scores summed over flights.

plan.5.simulator.value: Rank correlation with the true ranking, adjusted against raw (recovery study).

plan.5.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the specification was settled on the fitting years and the ranking is fit on 2023 onward.

plan.5.test.value: Rank changes between the raw and the adjusted ranking; effects with intervals.

plan.6.claim.value: The share of delay minutes that weather explains, estimated from the weather at both ends, differs from the share the reported weather field assigns.

plan.6.estimator.value: Arrival delay on hourly weather at the origin at departure and the destination at arrival (precipitation, snowfall, gusts over 40 km/h, low cloud, thunder, fog, freezing precipitation), with origin by hour, destination by hour and month fixed effects and the inbound aircraft's carried minutes as a control, on flights between two Core 30 airports; the attributable share is the fitted delay above calm weather.

plan.6.family.value: Airports compared on their national airspace system share are described, not tested.

plan.6.interval.value: Cluster robust by day on the weather coefficients, carried to the share.

plan.6.simulator.value: Weather share error and interval coverage against planted storms whose minutes the reported field under records by design (recovery study).

plan.6.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the specification is fixed here and the shares are reported on 2023 onward.

plan.6.test.value: Estimated weather share against the reported weather field's share on the same flights, with an interval.

plan.7.claim.value: Carrier meltdowns are visible as anomalies days before they end, and recovery speed differs by carrier.

plan.7.estimator.value: Daily cancellation rate and mean arrival delay per carrier and at the thirty busiest airports against the unit's previous 28 days (median and median absolute deviation, with floors); an alert episode opens above the threshold and stays open while the score stays above half of it; the threshold is chosen by cost over a grid; event studies of the two carrier meltdowns against other carriers at the same airports.

plan.7.family.value: One permutation test across carriers with at least five episodes; events are graded one by one.

plan.7.interval.value: Recovery time is a count of days; the excess is a sum, reported without a model interval.

plan.7.simulator.value: Detector precision and recall on the planted meltdown (recovery study).

plan.7.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the alert threshold is chosen on the fitting years and graded on 2023 onward.

plan.7.test.value: Recall on the known events of the reporting years and the first alert day against onset; false alarms per thousand unit days; whether carriers differ in alert episode length (Kruskal-Wallis H, permutation p).

plan.8.claim.value: The first departure of the aircraft's day is the most punctual, and the connection buffer needed to keep the misconnect probability under the stated line differs across the largest hubs.

plan.8.estimator.value: On time rate and mean delay by scheduled hour, day of week and month; misconnect probability by buffer from the joint same day distribution of inbound arrival and outbound departure delays at each hub.

plan.8.simulator.value: The day by day curve equals a brute force count of every same day pair of flights at a simulated hub (test); the calculator's estimates are scored later against the outcome month.

plan.8.split.value: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the curves are computed on 2023 onward.

plan.8.test.value: The buffer at which the probability crosses 10%, with the interior test.
